title: Kinetic Resistance
description:
A mod that adds an enchant that provides protection from kinetic sources of damage like elytra, anvils, and stalactites
Kinetic Resistance
body: A mod that adds an enchant that reduces the amount of damage taken from kinetic sources of damage like elytra, anvils, and stalactites. For example if you put this enchant on your elytra and you ran into a wall you would take less damage, then if you didn't have the enchant possibly preventing the user from dying. This enchant can also be applied to all other armor and also reduces damaged taken from falling anvils and stalactites.
